data.content:
I sent four disputes, worth $83.65 in deductions. The platform hasn't ruled on any of them yet.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win chance | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-48290 | $27.40 | 90% | The ticket lists a Fruit Bowl and a Green Smoothie, not the Protein Bowl named in the refund. The order was ready at 17:35 and picked up at 17:39. This is the strongest case. |
| DD-48251 | $21.00 | 77% | The ticket lists the Chia Pudding. The order was ready at 19:15 and picked up at 19:18. |
| DD-48230 | $18.75 | 80% | The ticket lists the Green Smoothie. The order was ready at 13:24 and picked up at 13:29. |
| DD-48267 | $16.50 | 90% | The ticket lists the Peanut Butter Bowl. The order was ready at 12:52 and picked up at 12:55. |

- **What the evidence shows:** For the three moderate cases, the ticket and handoff times show how the order was prepared. They don't prove what was in the bag.
- **Past results:** In similar past disputes, 2 of 3 were won. The loss involved a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket. DD-48251 is a wrong-item claim, and there's no past history for that type.
- **Repeat claims:** One account made three claims this period (DD-48244, DD-48251 and DD-48267). I left that out of the disputes, which state only ticket and handoff facts.

**Weak**
- **DD-48211 ($42.00, 35%):** There is no order ticket on file, so I didn't draft a dispute. **I need a photo of the ticket for this order.** It's the largest deduction, so it's worth finding if you can.

**Skipped or not checked**
- **DD-48301 ($12.00, 15%):** Skipped because the win chance is too low to be worth your time.
- **DD-47990 ($0.00):** Skipped because the deadline has already passed and the amount is $0.
- **DD-48244 ($14.25, 60%) and DD-48280 ($9.50, 60%):** I haven't checked evidence on these because I only worked the top five cases. I can run them next if you want.

The next deadline is 2026-11-24, 10 days away. Case notes are in `/plan.md`. When any of these disputes is decided, tell me the result and I'll record it so future cases can use it.
